title: Warhammer +1
summary: Warhammer with three proficiency weapon actions.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 + 1 one-handed or 1d10 + 1 two-handed Bludgeoning plus Strength. +1 to attack rolls. Martial, Versatile, Dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Acquisition: Traders using the magic melee table.
fields.Backbreaker: Action against a Large or smaller target for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Bludgeoning. Strength save against weapon-action DC or Prone for 2 turns. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action, normal weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2. Failure Dazes for 2 turns, removing Dexterity AC bonus, giving Disadvantage on Wisdom saves, and blocking spending Reaction points. Help clears it. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Weakening Strike: Action for 1d4 + attack ability modifier nonlethal weapon-type damage. Armed target makes a Strength save against weapon-action DC +2 or has Weak Grip for 2 turns. It gives Disadvantage on attacks and Strength saves. Help clears it. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
